text:
ivy: alert 1 — small but sustained 504 spike in eu-west2 inference pool since 06:07 UTC. looks like prefix-cache mem headroom regression from v3.2.1. Proposing micro-revert image registry.redwood/inference:v3.2.1-oomshield. Request expedited tiny canary + rollforward if green.
raj: paste one-line log + rollback plan? also propose canary size.
ivy: log sample:
```
2026-05-04T06:08:12Z inference-9 error: prefix_cache_headroom < threshold -> reclaim -> timeout 504
```
rollback: pin back to v3.2.0, cordon+drain new nodes, redeploy. runbook RB-999 "oomshield-rollback" linked.
tom: suggest ultra-slim canary: 2 pods in eu-west2, 10m observation, pause autoscaler, mem limit back to 7Gi, then 40% ramp for 8m. If green, full.
deploybot: Deploy requested by ivy -> eu-west2 canary (2 pods) image registry.redwood/inference:v3.2.1-oomshield. CI: smoke OK. Starting 10m observation.
oncall-bot: @ivy assigned oncall until 2026-05-04T10:00Z. Alerts: high-5xx-rate, p99-latency, node-mem.
(deploybot) 06:20 UTC: canary 2/2 ready, healthchecks OK, 5xx trending down.
raj: watching p95/p99 and memory headroom graphs every 2m. so far stable.
06:31 UTC - deploybot: 10m observation complete. canary stable. authorize ramp to 40%.
raj: +1 SRE. ramp to 40%, observe 8m.
deploybot: Ramping to 40% in eu-west2 for 8m.
06:40 UTC - deploybot: 8m complete. metrics: 5xx down ~87%, latency stable, no OOM traces.
ivy: proceeding to full rollout in eu-west2 with final 10m watch. changelog snippet ready.
changelog-bot: Reminder: please add changelog entry before closing thread.
deploybot: Full rollout complete. image: registry.redwood/inference:v3.2.1-oomshield. No alerts during watch windows.
ivy: created RB-999 follow-up to add CI integration for prefix-cache headroom tests. marking thread resolved once changelog is published.
changelog-bot: changelog entry added by ivy. thread marked RESOLVED. :white_check_mark:
